# halos_kill_switch (Data Source)

The kill list (GET /api/v1/killswitch). Read only: killing and unkilling are incident actions a human takes with `halo kill`, never Terraform. Use `any_active` in a `check` block to alert when something is killed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_kill_switch" "this" {}

# Alert (do not act) when something is killed: unkill is a human decision.
check "nothing_killed" {
  assert {
    condition     = !data.halos_kill_switch.this.any_active
    error_message = "the Halos kill switch is active; see `halo kill list`"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `any_active` (Boolean) True when at least one entry has `killed = true`.
- `id` (String) Always `kill-switch`.
- `killed` (Attributes List) Kill records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--killed))
- `version` (Number) Monotonic version of the signed kill list.

<a id="nestedatt--killed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `killed`

Read-Only:

- `at` (String) When, RFC 3339.
- `by` (String) Who set it.
- `experiment` (String) The experiment.
- `killed` (Boolean) Whether it is currently killed.
- `reason` (String) The recorded reason.
